fullText.simplified:
再见

    元少带着几个助手跑回了家，他又着急又难过，回到家就病了。
    为了打到南方去，元少准备了很长时间。他有厉害的军队，也有聪明的助手，他觉得自己很快就可以拿下南方，没想到第一仗就败了。他想到许右，想到放火的曹操，想到被烧的粮食，他都明白了。他越想越生气，越生气身体就越不好。
    两个月以后，曹操带着军队打到北方来了。
    元少的病还没有好，他带着两个儿子和曹操打。虽然元少有儿子的帮忙，但是他的军队太少了，所以这一次元少又败了。
    元少被儿子带回家，他的身体更不好了。他不能吃东西，也说不出话，没过几天就死了。
    曹操听说元少死了，带着军队又打了过来。这时候已经没有人和他打了，元少的助手和儿子们都跑了，曹操很快就拿下了北方。
    曹操来到北方，他站在元少家外面，看着没有花的院子和没有人的房子。他有点儿高兴，又有点儿难过。
    现在，这个院子和房子是他的了。
    现在，北方最重要的人是他了。
    元少，这个以前的朋友，再见了。
fullText.traditional:
再見

    元少帶著幾個助手跑回了家，他又著急又難過，回到家就病了。
    為了打到南方去，元少準備了很長時間。他有厲害的軍隊，也有聰明的助手，他覺得自己很快就可以拿下南方，沒想到第一仗就敗了。他想到許右，想到放火的曹操，想到被燒的糧食，他都明白了。他越想越生氣，越生氣身體就越不好。
    兩個月以後，曹操帶著軍隊打到北方來了。
    元少的病還沒有好，他帶著兩個兒子和曹操打。雖然元少有兒子的幫忙，但是他的軍隊太少了，所以這一次元少又敗了。
    元少被兒子帶回家，他的身體更不好了。他不能吃東西，也說不出話，沒過幾天就死了。
    曹操聽說元少死了，帶著軍隊又打了過來。這時候已經沒有人和他打了，元少的助手和兒子們都跑了，曹操很快就拿下了北方。
    曹操來到北方，他站在元少家外面，看著沒有花的院子和沒有人的房子。他有點兒高興，又有點兒難過。
    現在，這個院子和房子是他的了。
    現在，北方最重要的人是他了。
    元少，這個以前的朋友，再見了。

sentences.simplified: 元少带着几个助手跑回了家，他又着急又难过，回到家就病了。
sentences.traditional: 元少帶著幾個助手跑回了家，他又著急又難過，回到家就病了。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào dài zhe jǐ ge zhù shǒu pǎo huí le jiā tā yòu zháo jí yòu nán guò huí dào jiā jiù bìng le
sentences.english: Yuan Shao ran home with a few assistants. He was anxious and sad, and he fell ill when he got home.

sentences.simplified: 为了打到南方去，元少准备了很长时间。
sentences.traditional: 為了打到南方去，元少準備了很長時間。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le dǎ dào nán fāng qù yuán shào zhǔn bèi le hěn cháng shí jiān
sentences.english: In order to go fight in the south, Yuan Shao had prepared for a long time.

sentences.simplified: 他有厉害的军队，也有聪明的助手，
sentences.traditional: 他有厲害的軍隊，也有聰明的助手，
sentences.pinyin: tā yǒu lì hai de jūn duì yě yǒu cōng ming de zhù shǒu
sentences.english: He had formidable troops and smart assistants.

sentences.simplified: 他觉得自己很快就可以拿下南方，没想到第一仗就败了。
sentences.traditional: 他覺得自己很快就可以拿下南方，沒想到第一仗就敗了。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de zì jǐ hěn kuài jiù kě yǐ ná xià nán fāng méi xiǎng dào dì yī zhàng jiù bài le
sentences.english: He thought that he would be able to quickly take the south and hadn’t expected to lose the first battle.

sentences.simplified: 他想到许右，想到放火的曹操，想到被烧的粮食，他都明白了。
sentences.traditional: 他想到許右，想到放火的曹操，想到被燒的糧食，他都明白了。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng dào xǔ yòu xiǎng dào fàng huǒ de cáo cāo xiǎng dào bèi shāo de liáng shi tā dōu míng bai le
sentences.english: He thought of Xu You, of Cao Cao starting the fire, and of the grain that had been burned. He understood everything.

sentences.simplified: 他越想越生气，越生气身体就越不好。
sentences.traditional: 他越想越生氣，越生氣身體就越不好。
sentences.pinyin: tā yuè xiǎng yuè shēng qì yuè shēng qì shēn tǐ jiù yuè bù hǎo
sentences.english: The more he thought about it, the angrier he became. And the angrier he became, the worse his health got.

sentences.simplified: 两个月以后，曹操带着军队打到北方来了。
sentences.traditional: 兩個月以後，曹操帶著軍隊打到北方來了。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng ge yuè yǐ hòu cáo cāo dài zhe jūn duì dǎ dào běi fāng lái le
sentences.english: Two months later, Cao Cao fought his way to the north with his troops.

sentences.simplified: 元少的病还没有好，他带着两个儿子和曹操打。
sentences.traditional: 元少的病還沒有好，他帶著兩個兒子和曹操打。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào de bìng hái méi yǒu hǎo tā dài zhe liǎng ge ér zi hé cáo cāo dǎ
sentences.english: Yuan Shao still hadn’t recovered from his illness, so he took two sons with him to fight with Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 虽然元少有儿子的帮忙，但是他的军队太少了，所以这一次元少又败了。
sentences.traditional: 雖然元少有兒子的幫忙，但是他的軍隊太少了，所以這一次元少又敗了。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán yuán shào yǒu ér zi de bāng máng dàn shì tā de jūn duì tài shǎo le suǒ yǐ zhè yí cì yuán shào yòu bài le
sentences.english: Although Yuan Shao had the help of his sons, he had too few troops. So Yuan Shao lost again this time.

sentences.simplified: 元少被儿子带回家，他的身体更不好了。
sentences.traditional: 元少被兒子帶回家，他的身體更不好了。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào bèi ér zi dài huí jiā tā de shēn tǐ gèng bù hǎo le
sentences.english: Yuan Shao was brought home by his sons, and his health got even worse.

sentences.simplified: 他不能吃东西，也说不出话，没过几天就死了。
sentences.traditional: 他不能吃東西，也說不出話，沒過幾天就死了。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù néng chī dōng xi yě shuō bù chū huà méi guò jǐ tiān jiù sǐ le
sentences.english: He could not eat anything or say anything, and he died within a few days.

sentences.simplified: 曹操听说元少死了，带着军队又打了过来。这时候已经没有人和他打了，
sentences.traditional: 曹操聽說元少死了，帶著軍隊又打了過來。這時候已經沒有人和他打了，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo tīng shuō yuán shào sǐ le dài zhe jūn duì yòu dǎ le guò lái zhè shí hou yǐ jīng méi yǒu rén hé tā dǎ le
sentences.english: Cao Cao heard that Yuan Shao was dead and brought the troops to fight again. This time there was no one to fight him.

sentences.simplified: 元少的助手和儿子们都跑了，曹操很快就拿下了北方。
sentences.traditional: 元少的助手和兒子們都跑了，曹操很快就拿下了北方。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào de zhù shǒu hé ér zi men dōu pǎo le cáo cāo hěn kuài jiù ná xià le běi fāng
sentences.english: Yuan Shao’s assistants and sons had all ran away, and Cao Cao quickly took the north.

sentences.simplified: 曹操来到北方，他站在元少家外面，
sentences.traditional: 曹操來到北方，他站在元少家外面，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo lái dào běi fāng tā zhàn zài yuán shào jiā wài miàn
sentences.english: When Cao Cao came to the north, he stood outside Yuan Shao’s home.

sentences.simplified: 看着没有花的院子和没有人的房子。他有点儿高兴，又有点儿难过。
sentences.traditional: 看著沒有花的院子和沒有人的房子。他有點兒高興，又有點兒難過。
sentences.pinyin: kàn zhe méi yǒu huā de yuàn zi hé méi yǒu rén de fáng zi tā yǒu diǎn'r gāo xìng yòu yǒu diǎn'r nán guò
sentences.english: He looked at the courtyard without flowers and the house without people. He was a little happy and a little sad.

sentences.simplified: 现在，这个院子和房子是他的了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，這個院子和房子是他的了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài zhè ge yuàn zi hé fáng zi shì tā de le
sentences.english: This courtyard and house now belonged to him.

sentences.simplified: 现在，北方最重要的人是他了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，北方最重要的人是他了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài běi fāng zuì zhòng yào de rén shì tā le
sentences.english: He was now the most important person in the north.

sentences.simplified: 元少，这个以前的朋友，再见了。
sentences.traditional: 元少，這個以前的朋友，再見了。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào zhè ge yǐ qián de péng you zài jiàn le
sentences.english: Goodbye Yuan Shao, this former friend of mine.

sentence_translations: Yuan Shao ran home with a few assistants. He was anxious and sad, and he fell ill when he got home.
In order to go fight in the south, Yuan Shao had prepared for a long time.
He had formidable troops and smart assistants.
He thought that he would be able to quickly take the south and hadn’t expected to lose the first battle.
He thought of Xu You, of Cao Cao starting the fire, and of the grain that had been burned. He understood everything.
The more he thought about it, the angrier he became. And the angrier he became, the worse his health got.
Two months later, Cao Cao fought his way to the north with his troops.
Yuan Shao still hadn’t recovered from his illness, so he took two sons with him to fight with Cao Cao.
Although Yuan Shao had the help of his sons, he had too few troops. So Yuan Shao lost again this time.
Yuan Shao was brought home by his sons, and his health got even worse.
He could not eat anything or say anything, and he died within a few days.
Cao Cao heard that Yuan Shao was dead and brought the troops to fight again. This time there was no one to fight him.
Yuan Shao’s assistants and sons had all ran away, and Cao Cao quickly took the north.
When Cao Cao came to the north, he stood outside Yuan Shao’s home.
He looked at the courtyard without flowers and the house without people. He was a little happy and a little sad.
This courtyard and house now belonged to him.
He was now the most important person in the north.
Goodbye Yuan Shao, this former friend of mine.
